name: Phobos
source:
In the future, mankind successfully colonized Mars. However, the colonists eventually wished to be independent from Earth's control, and as a result a war began. Martian colonists used armored combat androids in battles. Eventually an uneasy truce was achieved, but Martian economy was badly damaged by war, and the planet became de facto dependent on Earth to survive.

Half a year later, a young Tokyo-based private investigator named Ryūichi and his assistant, the android Leyla, are contacted by the colonel of the former colonial army of Mars. It appears that someone has stolen documents containing top military secrets and disappeared with them. Ryūichi is asked to find that man, whom he knew quite well during the years of war...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/phobos]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
未来，人类成功殖民火星。然而，殖民者最终希望摆脱地球的控制，战争由此爆发。火星殖民军在战场上投入了装甲战斗机器人。后来，双方勉强达成休战，但火星经济已遭战争重创，整个星球实际上不得不依赖地球才能生存。

半年后，东京的年轻私家侦探龙一与机器人助手蕾拉接到前火星殖民军上校的联络。似乎有人盗走了载有最高军事机密的文件，随后携文件失踪。龙一受托寻找此人，而那还是一位他在战争年代十分熟悉的人……

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/phobos]Mobygames[/url]]
